title: Web board Dashboard page: productivity and spending by closed batch
summary: A read-only Dashboard view (after Costs) with Productivity and Spending tabs, one point per closed batch, range 10/20/all, gaps never zeroed. Figures computed on the server (board/dashboard.py, op dashboard.get, pytest); client-drawn SVG chart component; top 10 CRs by cost. EN and FR. batch-30.
